```java
public final class TemporalNetworkSolver {
    public static boolean isFeasible(List<TaskTiming> tasks, List<TemporalConstraint> constraints) {
        int n = tasks.size();
        int nodes = n + 1; // 0 = zero reference
        record Edge(int from, int to, long weight) {}
        List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            TaskTiming t = tasks.get(i);
            edges.add(new Edge(0, i + 1, t.latestFinishOffset() - t.durationMinutes())); // s_i ≤ f - d
            edges.add(new Edge(i + 1, 0, -t.earliestStartOffset())); // s_i ≥ e
        }
        for (TemporalConstraint c : constraints) {
            int a = indexOf(c.fromTaskKey), b = indexOf(c.toTaskKey);
            long da = tasks.get(a).durationMinutes();
            edges.add(new Edge(a + 1, b + 1, c.upperBound() + da));   // s_B - s_A ≤ U + d_A
            edges.add(new Edge(b + 1, a + 1, -(c.lowerBound() + da))); // s_B - s_A ≥ L + d_A
        }
        long[] dist = new long[nodes]; // all 0 = super-source trick
        for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
            boolean relaxed = false;
            for (Edge e : edges) {
                if (dist[e.to] > dist[e.from] + e.weight) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[e.from] + e.weight;
                    relaxed = true;
                }
            }
            if (!relaxed) return true;
            if (i == nodes - 1) return false; // negative cycle
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```
